note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real in Git Bash scripts via 'bash'. Companion/ note fields describe the half of a split capture that the kit does not record.
prepare: # laptop toolchain for the bash scripts: Git Bash first on PATH, python3 and zip shims in %TEMP% (the laptop has neither)

$shim = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mgshim'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\python3", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$@`"`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip.py", "import sys,os,zipfile`nz=zipfile.ZipFile(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[-2]),'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)`n[z.write(os.path.join(r,n),os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r,n),'.').replace(os.sep,'/')) for r,d,f in os.walk('.') for n in f]`nz.close()`n"); [IO.File]::WriteAllText("$shim\zip", "#!/bin/bash`nexec python `"`$(dirname `"`$0`")/zip.py`" `"`$@`"`n")
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }   # owner signs in as labadmin
if (-not (Get-Command func -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { npm install -g azure-functions-core-tools@4 --unsafe-perm true }
# westeurope must be listed by: az functionapp list-flexconsumption-locations (else use swedencentral here and in the commands)
$env:EP_HOST = az functionapp show -g rg-mglab-azure-01 -n $env:EP_APP --query defaultHostName -o tsv
$env:EP_KEY = az functionapp function keys list -g rg-mglab-azure-01 -n $env:EP_APP --function-name SubmitOrder --query default -o tsv   # kept in the process only, never printed

$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv; $st = az storage account list -g rg-mglab-azure-01 --query "[0].id" -o tsv; foreach ($role in 'Storage Blob Data Reader','Storage Queue Data Reader') { az role assignment create --assignee-object-id $me --assignee-principal-type User --role $role --scope $st -o none }

screens.name: local-run
prepare: Start-Process npx.cmd -ArgumentList '--yes','azurite','--silent','--location',"$env:TEMP\azurite" -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep -Seconds 10   # Azurite, the local storage emulator (not shown)
screens.note: Left/right split of the demo is one window here: the Functions host log and the smoke script output interleave. Wait for the function list before the smoke script (the pause covers the build).

screens.name: flex-overview
steps: Open the function app (Function App type)
On Overview show: hosting plan Flex Consumption and runtime .NET 10 (isolated)
Open the Functions tab: SubmitOrder, ProcessOrder, OrderPoison are listed
Optional: Settings > Scale and concurrency (maximum 40 instances, 2048 MB)
mask: tenant name/domain in the top bar and account menu

screens.name: blob-output
steps: Terminal half (HTTP 202 and orderId) comes from the prepare step of this screen
Open rg-mglab-azure-01 > storage account > Storage browser > Blob containers > orders-processed
Open the blob named <orderId>.json and view its content: subtotal 538.98, discount 26.95, total 512.03
mask: tenant name/domain in the top bar and account menu
function key (never visible: it is only in an environment variable)
prepare: Start-Sleep -Seconds 20   # let ProcessOrder write the blob and the poison order run its 5 attempts
screens.note: Companion terminal (smoke.sh against Azure, first block HTTP 202) is run by this screen's prepare, not recorded by the kit. It also creates the ZZZ-999 order that the poison screen needs.

screens.name: poison
steps: Open rg-mglab-azure-01 > Application Insights resource > Logs (close the query-picker dialog)
Paste and run: traces | where timestamp > ago(30m) | where message has "Pricing order" or message has "needs a human" | project timestamp, severityLevel, message | order by timestamp asc
If empty, wait a few minutes (telemetry lag) and run again
Show five 'Pricing order <id>, attempt 1..5' lines, then the OrderPoison severity 3 line 'failed 5 times and needs a human'
Optional: storage account > Storage browser > Queues > orders-poison
mask: tenant name/domain in the top bar and account menu

teardown: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'azurite|func start|WebHost|OrderIntake' -and $_.ProcessId -ne $PID } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
az group exists --name rg-mglab-azure-01   # false once deletion finishes
